name: MAE APS | Inteligência em Saúde
description: Tendências, variação territorial, práticas A–K e qualidade dos indicadores C3; dados agregados do SIAPS para gestão municipal.
scope: MAE APS - Gestao e Leitura. Nao e um painel clinico nem publica dados individuais.
caveats: Queda é mera variação observada; sem limiar clínico.
Apenas informações agregadas; anos/meses de competências distintos não representam pessoas únicas.

questions.name: Variação do C3 no mês (p.p.)
questions.sql: WITH u AS (SELECT competency, points_total / NULLIF(denominator,0) AS c3 FROM analytics.dashboard_competencies) SELECT ROUND(a.c3 - b.c3,2) AS variacao_pp FROM u a LEFT JOIN u b ON b.competency = (a.competency - INTERVAL '1 month')::date WHERE a.competency = (SELECT MAX(competency) FROM analytics.dashboard_competencies)

questions.name: Distritos com duas quedas consecutivas
questions.sql: WITH x AS (SELECT district_id, competency, points_total / NULLIF(denominator,0) AS c3 FROM analytics.dashboard_c3_district_monthly WHERE district_id IS NOT NULL) SELECT COUNT(*) AS distritos_em_queda FROM x a JOIN x b ON b.district_id=a.district_id AND b.competency=(a.competency-INTERVAL '1 month')::date JOIN x c ON c.district_id=a.district_id AND c.competency=(a.competency-INTERVAL '2 months')::date WHERE a.competency=(SELECT MAX(competency) FROM analytics.dashboard_competencies) AND a.c3 < b.c3 AND b.c3 < c.c3

questions.name: UBS com queda do C3 no último mês
questions.sql: WITH x AS (SELECT establishment_id, competency, points_total / NULLIF(denominator,0) AS c3 FROM analytics.dashboard_c3_establishment_monthly) SELECT COUNT(*) AS ubs_com_queda FROM x a JOIN x b ON b.establishment_id=a.establishment_id AND b.competency=(a.competency-INTERVAL '1 month')::date WHERE a.competency=(SELECT MAX(competency) FROM analytics.dashboard_competencies) AND a.c3 < b.c3

questions.name: Meses desde a última competência
questions.sql: SELECT (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age(date_trunc('month',CURRENT_DATE),MAX(competency))) * 12 + EXTRACT(MONTH FROM age(date_trunc('month',CURRENT_DATE),MAX(competency))))::integer AS meses_desde_ultima_competencia FROM analytics.dashboard_competencies

questions.name: Trajetória territorial do C3 — últimos seis meses
questions.sql: SELECT competency AS competencia, COALESCE(district_name,'Sem distrito') AS distrito, ROUND(points_total / NULLIF(denominator,0),2) AS c3 FROM analytics.dashboard_c3_district_monthly WHERE competency >= ((SELECT MAX(competency) FROM analytics.dashboard_competencies) - INTERVAL '5 months')::date ORDER BY competencia, distrito

questions.name: Mudança de desempenho por distrito (mês a mês)
questions.sql: WITH x AS (SELECT district_id, district_name, competency, points_total / NULLIF(denominator,0) AS c3, denominator FROM analytics.dashboard_c3_district_monthly) SELECT COALESCE(a.district_name,'Sem distrito') AS distrito, ROUND(b.c3,2) AS c3_anterior, ROUND(a.c3,2) AS c3_atual, ROUND(a.c3-b.c3,2) AS variacao_pp, a.denominator AS elegiveis_atual FROM x a JOIN x b ON a.district_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM b.district_id AND b.competency=(a.competency-INTERVAL '1 month')::date WHERE a.competency=(SELECT MAX(competency) FROM analytics.dashboard_competencies) ORDER BY variacao_pp ASC NULLS LAST, distrito

questions.name: UBS — maiores quedas entre competências
questions.sql: WITH x AS (SELECT establishment_id, cnes, establishment_name, district_name, competency, points_total / NULLIF(denominator,0) AS c3, denominator FROM analytics.dashboard_c3_establishment_monthly) SELECT a.cnes, a.establishment_name AS ubs, COALESCE(a.district_name,'Sem distrito') AS distrito, ROUND(a.c3,2) AS c3_atual, ROUND(b.c3,2) AS c3_anterior, ROUND(a.c3-b.c3,2) AS variacao_pp, a.denominator AS elegiveis FROM x a JOIN x b ON a.establishment_id=b.establishment_id AND b.competency=(a.competency-INTERVAL '1 month')::date WHERE a.competency=(SELECT MAX(competency) FROM analytics.dashboard_competencies) AND a.c3 < b.c3 ORDER BY variacao_pp ASC, a.establishment_name LIMIT 30

questions.name: Práticas A–K por distrito (última competência)
questions.sql: SELECT COALESCE(district_name,'Sem distrito') AS distrito, practice_code AS pratica, SUM(denominator) AS denominador, ROUND(100.0*SUM(fulfilled)/NULLIF(SUM(denominator),0),2) AS cobertura_pct FROM analytics.dashboard_c3_practice_summary WHERE competency=(SELECT MAX(competency) FROM analytics.dashboard_competencies) GROUP BY COALESCE(district_name,'Sem distrito'), practice_code ORDER BY distrito, pratica

questions.name: Práticas A–K — variação mensal em p.p.
questions.sql: WITH x AS (SELECT competency, practice_code, SUM(fulfilled) AS realizados, SUM(denominator) AS elegiveis, 100.0*SUM(fulfilled)/NULLIF(SUM(denominator),0) AS cobertura FROM analytics.dashboard_c3_practice_summary GROUP BY competency, practice_code) SELECT a.practice_code AS pratica, ROUND(b.cobertura,2) AS cobertura_anterior_pct, ROUND(a.cobertura,2) AS cobertura_atual_pct, ROUND(a.cobertura-b.cobertura,2) AS variacao_pp, a.elegiveis AS denominador_atual FROM x a JOIN x b ON a.practice_code=b.practice_code AND b.competency=(a.competency-INTERVAL '1 month')::date WHERE a.competency=(SELECT MAX(competency) FROM analytics.dashboard_competencies) ORDER BY variacao_pp ASC NULLS LAST, pratica

questions.name: Cobertura das práticas A–K ao longo do tempo
questions.sql: SELECT competency AS competencia, practice_code AS pratica, ROUND(100.0*SUM(fulfilled)/NULLIF(SUM(denominator),0),2) AS cobertura_pct FROM analytics.dashboard_c3_practice_summary WHERE competency >= ((SELECT MAX(competency) FROM analytics.dashboard_competencies)-INTERVAL '5 months')::date GROUP BY competency, practice_code ORDER BY competencia, pratica

questions.name: Qualidade — equipes sem distrito por mês
questions.sql: SELECT competency AS competencia, COUNT(*) AS equipes_total, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE district_id IS NULL) AS equipes_sem_distrito, ROUND(100.0*COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE district_id IS NULL)/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0),2) AS percentual_sem_distrito FROM analytics.dashboard_c3_team_monthly GROUP BY competency ORDER BY competency

questions.name: Qualidade — equipes sem população elegível
questions.sql: SELECT competency AS competencia, COUNT(*) AS equipes_total, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE denominator=0) AS equipes_sem_elegiveis, ROUND(100.0*COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE denominator=0)/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0),2) AS percentual_sem_elegiveis FROM analytics.dashboard_c3_team_monthly GROUP BY competency ORDER BY competency

questions.name: Qualidade — oscilação de elegíveis por distrito
questions.sql: SELECT competency AS competencia, COALESCE(district_name,'Sem distrito') AS distrito, denominator AS populacao_elegivel FROM analytics.dashboard_c3_district_monthly WHERE competency >= ((SELECT MAX(competency) FROM analytics.dashboard_competencies)-INTERVAL '5 months')::date ORDER BY competencia,distrito

questions.name: Acompanhamento — distritos com quedas persistentes
questions.sql: WITH x AS (SELECT district_id, district_name, competency, points_total / NULLIF(denominator,0) AS c3 FROM analytics.dashboard_c3_district_monthly WHERE district_id IS NOT NULL) SELECT a.district_name AS distrito, ROUND(c.c3,2) AS c3_antepenultimo, ROUND(b.c3,2) AS c3_penultimo, ROUND(a.c3,2) AS c3_atual, ROUND(a.c3-c.c3,2) AS variacao_dois_meses_pp FROM x a JOIN x b ON b.district_id=a.district_id AND b.competency=(a.competency-INTERVAL '1 month')::date JOIN x c ON c.district_id=a.district_id AND c.competency=(a.competency-INTERVAL '2 months')::date WHERE a.competency=(SELECT MAX(competency) FROM analytics.dashboard_competencies) AND a.c3 < b.c3 AND b.c3 < c.c3 ORDER BY variacao_dois_meses_pp ASC,distrito
